ADDENDA (Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Environmental Policy) <Presidential Decree No. 33479, May 23, 2023>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on June 11, 2023.

Article 2 (Amendments to other statutes and regulations) Paragraphs (1) through (12) Omitted.
(13) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows:
In the introductory part of Article 21(2), "Environmental Preservation Association" is replaced with "Korea Environmental Conservation Institute".
Paragraphs (14) through (16) Omitted.
